events.title: The Making of Chinese Art Song — Lecture-Recital & Masterclass
events.description: Dr. Jietong Fu, tenor, and Dr. Xin Wu, pianist, co-presented a lecture-recital and masterclass on Chinese art song. Through discussion, musical demonstrations, and performance, they explored Chinese poetry, Mandarin diction, musical traditions, and the singer–pianist partnership, followed by an interactive masterclass.

events.title: Sound and Image - A Musical Journey Through Classical Chinese Poetry
events.description: Dr. Jietong Fu and Dr. Xin Wu presented the beauty of Classical Chinese poetry through art song, piano, and carefully curated imagery.
